Item 1. Business
Company Background
The Company designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September.

Human Capital
The Company believes that its people play an important role in its success, and strives to attract, develop and retain the best talent. As of September 28, 2024, the Company had approximately 164,000 full-time equivalent employees.

Item 5. Market for Registrant's Common Equity
The Company's common stock is traded on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC under the symbol AAPL. As of October 18, 2024, there were 23,301 shareholders of record.

Item 1A. Risk Factors
The filing discusses macroeconomic risks, business risks including dependence on outsourcing partners in Asia, legal and regulatory compliance risks including EU Digital Markets Act investigations and a Department of Justice antitrust lawsuit filed March 2024, and financial risks including currency fluctuation exposure.

Item 3. Legal Proceedings
On March 25, 2024, the European Commission opened formal noncompliance investigations against the Company under the Digital Markets Act.
On March 21, 2024, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a civil antitrust lawsuit alleging monopolization in the smartphone markets.
